messages:
sophie: Heads up — opened a docs PR to make console dashboard date/cost widgets i18n-friendly. Link: https://github.com/redwoodifi/docs/pull/412. Need quick review of snippets and any broken links for EU/APAC locales.

mari: ack, will review in ~30m. main risks? formatting, UX copy, or examples? 🤔

sophie: mostly formatting + examples. We previously hardcoded `en-US` in the JS snippet and the cost tooltip uses `USD` formatting only. Also found a stale link to /docs/console/timezones in the embed.

lin: quick suggestion — prefer Intl APIs instead of moment. Example for dashboard snippet:
```js
const fmt = new Intl.DateTimeFormat(locale || navigator.language, { year: 'numeric', month: 'short', day: 'numeric', hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' });
widgetDate = fmt.format(new Date(timestamp));
```
This handles calendars and 24h vs 12h automatically.

tony: for cost: use Intl.NumberFormat with currency code from account settings, e.g.
```js
new Intl.NumberFormat(locale, { style: 'currency', currency: account.currency });
```
Fallback to `USD` if unset.

mari: good. Also check examples in Python SDK page — they currently format timestamps with `strftime` which is locale-unsafe. Suggest adding babel or use `zoneinfo` + localized format string. Short snippet for Python:
```py
from datetime import datetime
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
dt = datetime.fromtimestamp(ts, tz=ZoneInfo(user_tz))
pretty = dt.strftime('%x %X')  # still simple, note: recommend babel for true locale
```

sophie: noted — I'll swap the JS snippet and add a Python caveat note recommending babel for localized month names. Also fixed the /docs/console/timezones link to point to /docs/console/localization.

docs-bot: Link-checker found one more broken link: /docs/console/old-costs -> 404. PR needs to update or remove references.

sophie: thanks, fixed in the branch and pushed. @mari can you sanity-check the updated snippets and the new i18n callouts? I added a short migration note under "Dashboard snippets -> Internationalization".

mari: skimmed — snippets look good. A couple of nits on wording: change "locale-aware" to "locale-sensitive" in two places, and add a small example showing `navigator.language` fallback.

lin: also add a test snippet for RTL (arabic) rendering for the tooltip — one line note is fine.

sophie: done. updated PR with those tweaks and added a unit test to the docs examples harness to ensure Intl usage shows different outputs for `en-US` vs `de-DE`.

tony: leaving a +1. merge once CI passes.

mari: +1 from me too. Will merge after the link-check job finishes.

sophie: thanks all — filing a small follow-up issue to track broader console i18n work for other widgets (filters, CSV exports).
